'''2010 US West Nationals Day 2 Chris Fanchi DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Fanchi]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Username:''' avtwal80
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2

== Decklist ==

The sheet says the deck is the same as the player's [[2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Chris Fanchi DS Ralltiir Operations|list from the day before]], with these changes: Blizzard Scout 1 (V) instead of non-V. The list below applies them.
